desktop.title: Sycamore Pricing (2026): $4 per student per month, every module included
desktop.metaDescription: Sycamore is $4 per student per month with all modules included: SIS, gradebook, attendance, admissions, tuition, payments, parent app, and communications. Published, predictable, and flexible.
